title: Positive computable weights with an effective tail recover halting from exact total mass

statement.quantifiers: Every c.e.-complete halting set K and the explicit positive computable disjoint-band weights w_k=2r/((k+1)^2-r^2),r=1/sqrt8 or1/4.
statement.assertion: p=sum_(k in K)w_k is left-c.e. and has exact Turing degree0prime; no superincreasing-weight condition is required.
assumptions: Oracle p gives certified arbitrary-precision upper approximations.

inputs: A query k, known rational c<w_k, mass lower enumeration and exact-real oracle.
outputs: A terminating membership decision from residual upper-minus-lower mass.
interface.precision: Exact real-computation conclusion, not an obstruction to every coarse approximation.
costs: No computable halting-dependent convergence rate; idealized long-time phase probability.
Rational-endpoint factor16 is analytic/audited, script only factor8.

proof_mechanism: K computes mass by prefix plus effective tail.
Enumeration produces certified monotone lower mass tending p.
Once upper p minus current lower mass<c, missing k cannot ever add its positive weight.
Exact disjoint intervals identify mass with once-randomized frozen-parameter explosion probability.
obstructions: Noncomputable mass is not automatically algorithmically random.
Arbitrary unrelated phase-volume construction needs its own effective-tail and exact-band proofs.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire exact disjoint positive bands and a computable all-index tail before asserting degree of total phase volume.

review.source_reported: Source reports internally reconstructed mathematics with scoped independent analytic audits; finite checks are not proof certification; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
